Container.Name: mt-photos-insightface
Container.Overview:
MT Photos 非官方 InsightFace 人脸识别 API，使用 InsightFace 模型为 MT Photos 提供人脸检测与特征提取服务。镜像内置默认 buffalo_l 模型。
English: Unofficial InsightFace API for MT Photos, providing face detection and feature extraction with InsightFace. The image bundles the default buffalo_l model.
Container.Description: Unofficial MT Photos InsightFace API using devfox101/mt-photos-insightface-unofficial:latest. Add this service's address and matching API_AUTH_KEY in MT Photos settings.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: MT Photos InsightFace face facial recognition API
Container.Requires: 需要 x86_64 系统。服务启动后，需在 MT Photos 后台添加人脸识别 API 地址及相同的 API_AUTH_KEY。此镜像由社区项目提供，并非 MT Photos 官方镜像。 English: Requires x86_64. Add this face API address and the same API_AUTH_KEY in MT Photos settings. This is a community image, not an official MT Photos image.

Config.Name: API 端口 / API Port
Config.Description: MT Photos InsightFace 人脸识别 API 端口。 English: MT Photos InsightFace API port.

Config.Name: API 密钥 / API_AUTH_KEY
Config.Description: 验证 API 请求的密钥；在 MT Photos 后台添加人脸识别 API 时填写相同值。建议修改默认值。 English: API request authentication key. Enter the same value in MT Photos face API settings. Changing the default is recommended.
